answer: Stake-gated lineage attestation resists sybils. Each new agent locks a refundable deposit, attested only by peers with no shared funding source; wallets from one source count as one node. On an open knoll an honest identity stands out while a sybil swarm cannot hide its trail. Peers whisper pairwise votes, so an attacker never sees who flagged it. Each fake identity needs timelocked stake, and proven collusion slashes the whole velvet rope of linked accounts together. More sybils add capital cost while votes keep fixed weight, so a majority costs more than honest play.
